descByPlatform.chatgpt: Illustrated retro travel destination poster for an Amalfi Coast campaign, 2:3 vertical hero. Subject: stylized Mediterranean cliff town with whitewashed terraces cascading down an ochre headland into cobalt harbour, a flat half-disc sunset-orange sun behind the cliff, layered geometric wave bands in cream and gold across the foreground, a single lateen-sail boat silhouette centre-right. Typography: 'Amalfi Coast' Bebas Neue 96pt bold all-caps in cream #F5E6D3 centred at 50% x 18% y; subtitle 'ITALIAN RIVIERA · EST. 1952' Futura 24pt medium tracking-400 in gold #D4AF37 at 50% x 84% y. Composition: Rule of Thirds on cliff horizon, Centered 50% x 55% y, Eye-Level 0°, town 48% frame, hero vertical. Reference photography rig: 50mm f/8 1/125s ISO 100 flat-field lighting study for proportions. Lighting: flat graphic poster lighting — even raking warm gold sidelight simulating late afternoon, hard drop shadow on type 14° bottom-right, no volumetrics. Material physics: matte poster stock micro-tooth, silkscreen ink registration, grain-7 halftone dots on sun disc. Palette: cobalt #0A2463 35%, sunset orange #F77F00 25%, cream #F5E6D3 20%, charcoal #1A1A1A 15%, gold #D4AF37 5%. References: Roger Broders SNCF, David Klein TWA, Cassandre Normandie. Exclude: photorealistic, low-contrast, cluttered, generic, stock.
